tagline: Read IMAP mailboxes and send explicitly approved SMTP messages.

commands.summary: Read bounded message envelopes, flags, dates, sizes, and bounded body parts from one IMAP mailbox.

flags.name: mailbox
flags.summary: Mailbox to read for this command; use a distinct credential/state for a different incremental mailbox.

commands.summary: Plan, preview, approve, and submit one typed SMTP message; the preview includes the exact unmasked MIME payload.

flags.name: to
flags.summary: One or more primary recipient addresses.

flags.name: bcc
flags.summary: Optional blind-carbon-copy envelope recipient addresses; shown in the unmasked preview envelope but not as a MIME header.

flags.name: body
flags.summary: Message body; shown unmasked in the preview payload.

flags.name: body-content-type
flags.summary: Body MIME media type; defaults to text/plain.

flags.name: attachment
flags.summary: Relative regular file paths beneath the runtime .polymetrics staging root; absolute paths, traversal, and escaping symlinks are rejected before preview.

commands.risk: SMTP submission is externally visible and irreversible after the server accepts it.
commands.approval: Requires plan, unmasked preview, approval evidence, and typed destructive confirmation.
examples: pm email message send --credential polly-mail --to recipient@example.invalid --subject 'Hello' --body 'Hello from Polymetrics' --plan email-send

help_topics.name: incremental
help_topics.summary: Messages use a mailbox-specific UIDVALIDITY+UID cursor; hard deletions are not observable by polling; full message refresh is unavailable pending #3810.

help_topics.name: submission-safety
help_topics.summary: SMTP is send-only; message send is non-batchable, destructive, approval-gated, and previewed without masking.
